name: Restock Notifier For WooCommerce
author: pcprajapat

sections.description:
Restock Notifier For WooCommerce adds a lightweight and fully customizable “Notify Me” form to out-of-stock product pages. Customers can subscribe with their email address and will receive automatic notifications when the product is restocked.

Ideal for boosting sales and improving customer retention by keeping interested buyers in the loop — even when inventory runs low.

🔑 Key Features:

  • 💬 Display a customizable “Notify Me” form on out-of-stock products
  • 📧 Automatically sends email alerts when stock is updated
  • 🗂️ Stores subscriber emails in a custom database table
  • 🔁 Prevents duplicate subscriptions
  • 🧩 Works with variable products (e.g. color/size)
  • 🎨 Easily override the form template (form-out-of-stock.php)
  • 🌐 Translation-ready with .pot file included
  • ⚙️ Clean, optimized, and developer-friendly code
  • 📊 Admin panel with subscriber list and email log
  • 🖌️ Live form design customization with preview
  • 📥 Export subscribers to CSV
  • 🧹 Supports background cleanup and batch notification controls
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/restock-notifier-for-woocommerce directory, or install it via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. That’s it! The “Notify Me” form will now appear automatically on out-of-stock product pages.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support variable products?

Yes. Notifications are tied to specific product variations (e.g. size or color).

Can I customize the design of the form?

Yes! You can override the form-out-of-stock.php template in your theme or use the built-in design panel to visually adjust styles.

Can I export subscriber data?

Yes, subscriber data can be exported as a CSV file from the admin panel.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes. It uses standard WordPress i18n functions and includes a .pot file for translation.
